summary: Zoomcar Holdings filed an 8-K reporting a fourth closing of a private placement of Series A units under Regulation D. It issued 498 units at $1,000 each, comprising convertible preferred shares and warrants, for non-cash consideration of $498,000 to satisfy accrued obligations. The offering totals up to $5 million plus overallotment, with closings ongoing. This is a routine capital-raising event, not a special situation. No board recommendation, advisors, or structural complexities beyond standard terms. Watch for subsequent closings and conversion dilution, but no risk-arb angle.
